page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-8x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary hardware feature of this instance is its integrated GPU array, consisting of eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs with a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration operates on a KVM hypervisor. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Given the high density of eight GPUs relative to the 64 dedicated vCPUs, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that scale horizontally across multiple graphics processors rather than relying on local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, multi-stream video transcoding, large-scale rendering, and GPU-accelerated scientific simulations.
